name: structural maintenance of chromosomes 1A

function.text: SMC1A encodes structural maintenance of chromosomes protein 1A. Annotated molecular activities include ATP hydrolysis activity and protein heterodimerization activity. It participates in DNA repair and meiotic cell cycle.

germline.text: Strong or definitive GenCC assertions link constitutional variants to X-linked complex neurodevelopmental disorder (x-linked); Cornelia de Lange syndrome 2 (x-linked). Additional curated associations are listed below.

somatic.text: Somatic sequence alterations have cohort-level candidate-driver evidence in Acute Myeloid Leukemia. This gene-level statistical evidence requires allele-specific review and does not establish the effect of every variant.
